B10_00.process: Limiting macrophage migration toward inflammatory signals during immune responses.
B10_00.disease: Chronic inflammation, tissue damage and impaired wound healing.
B10_00.tissue: Macrophages at sites of injury or infection.

B10_01.process: Restraining production of granulocytes from bone marrow progenitors.
B10_01.disease: Myeloid leukaemias, especially acute promyelocytic leukaemia, and inflammatory tissue damage.
B10_01.tissue: Bone marrow myeloid progenitors, neutrophils and eosinophils.

B10_02.process: Restraining mast cell release of histamine and inflammatory mediators.
B10_02.disease: Allergy, anaphylaxis, atopic disease and skin inflammation.
B10_02.tissue: Mast cells in skin, airways and blood vessels.

B10_03.process: Dampening innate immune interferon responses to cytosolic DNA.
B10_03.disease: Interferonopathies, lupus-like autoimmunity and sterile inflammation.
B10_03.tissue: Most cell types, especially immune cells.

B10_04.process: Damping antigen-triggered acute inflammatory and hypersensitivity responses.
B10_04.disease: Anaphylaxis, immune complex disease and systemic autoimmunity.
B10_04.tissue: B cells, mast cells and phagocytes.

B10_05.process: Limiting neutrophil migration into tissues during inflammation.
B10_05.disease: Acute lung injury, ischemia-reperfusion injury and chronic inflammatory disease.
B10_05.tissue: Neutrophils, blood vessels and inflamed tissue.

B10_06.process: Dampening innate immune sensing of DNA by Toll-like receptors.
B10_06.disease: Lupus and other interferon-driven autoimmune diseases.
B10_06.tissue: Plasmacytoid dendritic cells and other immune cells.

B10_07.process: Limiting white blood cell exit from blood vessels into tissue.

B10_08.process: Restraining proliferation of developing T cells in the thymus.
B10_08.tissue: Thymus, thymocytes and thymic stromal cells.

B10_09.process: Restraining formation of bone-resorbing cells during bone remodelling.
B10_09.disease: Osteoporosis, inflammatory bone erosion and high-turnover bone disease.
B10_09.tissue: Bone, osteoclast precursors and myeloid cells.

B10_10.process: Restraining differentiation of myeloid progenitors into monocytes.
B10_10.tissue: Bone marrow myeloid progenitors and monocytes.

B10_11.process: Dampening innate antiviral interferon responses to cytoplasmic viral RNA.
B10_11.disease: Viral infection, autoinflammatory disease and interferonopathies.

B10_12.process: Limiting antibody production by B cells.
B10_12.disease: Autoimmunity, hypergammaglobulinaemia and allergic IgE responses.
B10_12.tissue: B cells, plasma cells and regulatory T cells.

B10_13.process: Limiting granulocyte migration toward inflammatory signals.
B10_13.disease: Sepsis, arthritis and chronic lung disease.
B10_13.tissue: Neutrophils and eosinophils in inflamed tissue.

B10_14.process: Restraining development of B cells from bone marrow progenitors.
B10_14.tissue: Bone marrow lymphoid progenitors and B cells.

B10_15.process: Limiting inflammatory cytokine production by macrophages.
B10_15.disease: Septic shock, chronic inflammatory disease and fibrosis.

B10_16.process: Dampening cellular responses to interferon-gamma during immune activation.
B10_16.disease: Autoimmunity, tumour immune evasion and intracellular infections.

B10_17.process: Restraining inflammasome assembly and inflammatory cytokine release.
B10_17.disease: Periodic fever syndromes, gout, atherosclerosis and neuroinflammation.
B10_17.tissue: Macrophages, microglia and other innate immune cells.

B10_18.process: Restraining differentiation of regulatory T cells.
B10_18.disease: Autoimmunity, infection control and tumour immunity.
B10_18.tissue: T cells, especially regulatory T cells.

B10_19.process: Limiting T cell migration and trafficking.
B10_19.disease: Autoimmune tissue damage and tumour immune exclusion.

B10_20.disease: Chronic inflammatory disease, autoimmunity and cancer.
B10_20.tissue: T helper cells and other immune cells.

B10_21.process: Shutting off type I interferon signalling after antiviral responses.

B10_22.process: Restraining differentiation and maturation of dendritic cells.
B10_22.disease: Autoimmunity, transplant rejection and unwanted inflammation.

B10_23.process: Restraining differentiation of monocytes into macrophages.

B10_24.process: Limiting monocyte migration toward inflammatory signals.
B10_24.disease: Chronic inflammation, atherosclerosis, fibrosis and impaired wound healing.
